name: Rodd & Gunn New Zealand Limited
note: Company behind the Rodd & Gunn menswear brand. New Zealand Companies Register (fetched 2026-09-30; last updated 30 Mar 2026): Winona R&G, LLC (Chicago) 126,651,805 shares (57.30%); Michael Beagley and his investment trust company 69,506,858 (31.45%); Zippin Pty Limited 22,957,831 (10.39%); two smaller parcels; 221,017,780 shares in all. BusinessDesk (4 Apr 2018) describes Winona Capital as a Chicago-based private equity firm that invests in consumer brands.
